# KayKit Halloween Bits 1.0 (CC0)

By Kay Lousberg — https://kaylousberg.com · source: https://github.com/KayKit-Game-Assets/KayKit-Halloween-Bits-1.0
License: Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0), see `LICENSE.txt`.

glTF (`.gltf` + `.bin`) + the shared gradient atlas `halloweenbits_texture.png`. Used for the lore stele
(gravestone), boss gate arch, FOE marker post, crypt decor (broken grave, coffin, skulls, bones, ribcage,
candles, shrine_candles in the lancet-arch alcoves, lantern_hanging under the vault) and the verdant ruins' pine
(tree_pine_yellow_medium recoloured green). Skulls / ribcage / skull candle are decimated at build time
(`dungeon_cc0.lowpoly`) for the phone budget.
